<b>Thread Storm</b> is a [[Skills|Skill]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it creates a whirl of [[Silk]] around [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]].

== Function ==
Creates a whirl of Silk centred on Hornet that strikes 5 times, which can be extended to 11 times via repeated input of the [[Controls (Silksong)|SKILL/TOOL]] button. Thread Storm deals [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Needle|0.75x Needle Damage]] in the first 4 hits, the 5th hit deals 0.25x Needle Damage, and the remaining hits deal damage equal to current Needle Level (minimum of 1). Thread storm will destroy most weak projectiles.

=== Modifiers ===
* [[Volt Filament]] electrifies Thread Storm, increasing the damage by 25% and adding 2 ticks of 5 damage (plus another when extended). 
* [[Shaman Crest]] sheathes Thread Storm in Soul, increasing the damage by 40%.
** Volt Filament and Shaman Crest's damage increases add together to grant +65% damage.
* [[Egg of Flealia]] reduces the cost of Thread Storm to 3 Silk while at full health.

== How to Acquire ==
Thread Storm can be acquired from a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] in the north of the [[Craw Lake]] area of [[Greymoor]]. After defeating an [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)|Enemy Gauntlet]] of [[Craw]]s, [[Tallcraw]]s, and [[Squatcraw]]s, a lever can be struck to deploy a series of balloons that provide access to the skill.

* Thread Storm was one of Hornet's attacks [[Hornet Protector|as a boss in <i>Hollow Knight</i>]], with the Skill and attack even sharing the same sprites.
